method_notes: Camden community schools (Starting School in Camden 2026 guide, community-school criteria pp. 25-26, quoting Camden LA admission arrangements): final criterion is 'other children, with priority given to those living closest to the school measured "as the crow flies" from the home address to the centre of the school', 'measured in a straight line from the home address to the school using a computerised mapping system'. Address coordinates come from Camden's Local Land and Property Gazetteer (BS7666); non-Camden addresses use coordinates validated by the home LA (guide p. 13 'Cut-off distances'). Tie-break for identical distances (e.g. flats): random ordering by the computer system (note 9). Offer-table figures are 'Furthest child offered on the offer date calculated in miles'. Table colour-codes some VA figures: 'Route B only' (Emmanuel) and 'Open criterion only' (Hampstead Parochial, Holy Trinity & St Silas, Kentish Town, St Paul's). 17 VA, 2 free schools and 1 academy (King's Cross) set their own arrangements; Abacus Belsize has a catchment area. Their measuring methods were not checked.

gaps: 2026 figures NOT obtained: camden.gov.uk (Cloudflare) blocked automated access to every page and PDF, and no copy of the Starting School in Camden 2027 guide (which holds 2026 offer-day figures) was found on any school site, so 2026 is left out of years_found and the distances (the borough has only 2025 and 2024). A person should download that guide from camden.gov.uk/primary-admissions by hand. The 2025 and 2024 figures come from the council's 2026 guide, re-hosted unchanged on Brecknock Primary's website. The 2026/27 admission arrangements PDF could not be fetched; the method comes from the criteria quoted in the guide. VA, free-school and academy measuring methods were not checked, so they are assumed to use the straight-line default. Abacus 2025 is '*' (check with the school). West Hampstead's 2025 figure of 9.692 miles is recorded as printed but looks like a typo or a one-off. Brecknock's PAN shows as 30 in the 2026-entry list but 60 in the 2025 table. Colour shading ('Route B only', 'Open criterion only') was read from a rendered image of p.40. Postcodes come from the guide's school pages (some text was split across columns) and were not checked against GIAS. The council's 2027-28 proposals to cut PANs (e.g. Argyle 45 to 30) are not reflected.
